name: Cave-Factory
description: Docker Container for Cave Factory Minecraft Modpack The docker on first run will download the same version as tagged of Cave Factory and install it. This can take a while as the Forge installer can take a bit to complete. You can watch the logs and it will eventually finish. After the first run it will simply start the server.

paths.name: Installed Location
paths.description: Path to store the installed server files.

variables.name: EULA
variables.description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting. Set to 'true' to accept.
